name: Moonbase
overview: Moonfin server plugin for Jellyfin with web app hosting, settings sync, theming, and Seerr integrations
description: Moonbase is the Moonfin server plugin for Jellyfin, powering settings sync, the Moonfin Web app at /Moonfin/Web/, a built-in theme editor with custom theme APIs, media bar and ratings integrations, and Seerr proxy/SSO with admin defaults and broadcasts across Moonfin clients.

versions.changelog:
Cinema Mode test build from feat/cinema-mode-skip-trailer-settings-final (681a7e291b8189f1f05d6805ed89d3141f0c40df).

- Recover the advertised movie or series from an attached trailer sharing a private video's exact file path (Jellyfin and Emby).
- Add an optional filename-based TMDB title lookup fallback, disabled by default; normal metadata, attached-owner and embedded-ID identification continues to work without enabling it.
- Ignore generic promotional-only filenames such as Trailer.mp4 and Official Trailer.mp4.
- Clarify Cinema Mode's Seerr Request and availability identification settings.
